description: Archive, mark as read, label, or move to Trash every email matching a search in one account. ALWAYS two steps: first call with dryRun=true (default) to get a preview and a confirmToken, show the preview to the user, and only after they agree call again with the same arguments, dryRun=false and that confirmToken. Archive / mark read / label need drafts mode; trash needs full mode (recoverable for 30 days in Gmail).

account.description: Account alias or email address. Omit to use the default account. No accounts connected yet.

confirmToken.description: Token from the preview; required when dryRun=false.

label.description: For action "label": label name to add.

max.description: At most this many emails (default 200; trash max 500).

query.description: Search selecting the emails, e.g. "from:newsletter@shop.gr older_than:30d".

name: bulk_cleanup
title: Bulk clean-up with preview
